title: Drawn instruments (our own)
description: Original instruments as control points and parameters, no audio: a bass guitar, an electric guitar, a viola and a cello (single cycles with per-register shapes), a vowel-morphing choir pad (three keyframes) and a computed drum kit (kick, snare, closed and open hat, clap, tom; seeded variants). Wavetables and one-shots are built in the page when a program names a wt_drawn_* or dr_* sound. CC0-1.0.

ingredients.title: Drawn bass and choir pad
ingredients.description: control points and parameters; wavetables built in memory on first use

ingredients.title: Computed drum kit
ingredients.description: six drum models as parameter sets, four seeded variants each; one-shots built in memory on first use
